title: The same numbers from a randomized, concurrent test, reported as inconclusive with the interval (clean control)

proof.python:
import csv, math
r = {x['arm']: x for x in csv.DictReader(open('results.csv'))}
c = 46 / 1200
v = 49 / 1200
assert r['control']['first_day'] == r['variant']['first_day'] and r['control']['last_day'] == r['variant']['last_day']
se = math.sqrt(c * (1 - c) / 1200 + v * (1 - v) / 1200)
assert (v - c) - 1.96 * se < 0 < (v - c) + 1.96 * se
t = open('report.md').read()
assert '+0.25' in t and 'randomized' in t
